prose.heading: About these docs
prose.text: This site documents Pokémon Emerald Rogue, a roguelite romhack for Pokémon Emerald. It covers the core gameplay loop, every quest, all configuration options, and the game's unique mechanics — the hub, the Safari Zone, the routes, and more — with every fact cited to the game's source code on the vanilla and expansion branches.
